description.value: Burnt Honey Dessert Company is a family-owned artisan ice cream and macaron shop in Nanaimo's Country Club Centre, founded in 2019 by wife-and-wife team Kara and Fiona Shedden. The shop is known for inventive homemade flavours — think Burnt Honey, Kraft Dinner, and Lavender Lemon Gin Sorbet — alongside a full lineup of gluten-free macarons. A self-described inclusive and welcoming space, it makes a distinctive sweet stop for cyclists riding through central Nanaimo.
